rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
# Debian's sources come without the manual, which is not free. The build # system wants the file to be there. echo '@setfilename bison.info' > doc/bison.texi
# Debian's patches change the build system. autoreconf -vfi bh_autotools_dev_update
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-silent-rules
rules.build:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
# Touch all files in the dependency tree of bison.info to # inhibit makeinfo invocation in the build process. install -d doc/figs touch -t 200001010000.01 \ doc/bison.info \ doc/bison.help \ doc/figs/example.txt \ doc/figs/example-reduce.txt \ doc/figs/example-shift.txt \ doc/*.texi \ build-aux/cross-options.pl \ src/getargs.c
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS"
